name: Lattice
description: Lattice is a people management platform built around continuous performance reviews, goal (OKR) tracking, and employee engagement surveys, with add-on compensation and career-growth modules and an AI Agent layered across them, sold as separately priced modules that can be combined.
best_for: People teams that want to buy performance management, goal tracking, and engagement surveys as separate, transparently priced modules rather than a single bundled HRIS suite.
features: Performance: structured performance reviews and tools to identify high performers
Goals & OKRs: goal setting and tracking with team alignment
Engagement: employee engagement surveys with AI-assisted insights
Grow (add-on): career progression and development planning
Compensation (add-on): pay planning and compensation review cycles
Habits: built-in 1:1s, weekly updates, feedback requests, and Q&A boards included with every base product
AI Agent providing proactive assistance to employees, managers, and leaders
Integrations with 30+ tools including Workday, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Salesforce
pros: Publishes real per-seat pricing for each module instead of requiring a sales quote for every deal
Modules (Performance, Goals & OKRs, Engagement, Compensation, Grow) can be purchased individually and combined based on need
Lists SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA on its public trust center
cons: Billing is annual-only, in USD only, with a $4,000 minimum annual agreement
No free trial is published; only a sales demo is offered
Compensation and Grow are paid add-ons on top of the base per-seat module price, so full functionality raises the effective per-seat cost

tiers.name: Engagement

tiers.name: Goals & OKRs

tiers.name: Grow add-on

tiers.name: Compensation add-on
tiers.notes: Add-on on top of a base module; compensation planning and review cycles.

alternatives.name: Culture Amp
alternatives.description: An employee experience platform combining engagement/pulse surveys with continuous performance management and AI-assisted people analytics.
alternatives.best_for: Companies that want a dedicated engagement-and-performance platform with cross-customer benchmarking rather than modular per-seat pricing.

alternatives.name: BambooHR
alternatives.description: An HRIS for small and mid-sized businesses that includes performance management and satisfaction surveys alongside core HR record-keeping.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that want performance and engagement features bundled into a core HR system of record rather than purchased as standalone modules.
